cases.question: Identify the active substance in Yates Success Ultra Insect Control.
cases.answer:
The active substance in Yates Success Ultra Insect Control is spinetoram. The mode of action of spinetoram is a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR) allosteric modulator-binding site I, which affects insect neural action. Allelic activation of its receptor (different from binding site-II of group 32) causes hyperexcitability of the insect nervous system. Acetylcholine is the main excitatory neurotransmitter in the insect central nervous system. [D1]

This information is based on the New Zealand pesticide dataset.
